### Figure Description: Stage 2: Concept Overlap Identification and Pair Generation

This figure is designed as a publication-quality academic data flow diagram, depicting a top-to-bottom process for identifying concept overlaps and generating question pairs. It maintains a clean, flat design aesthetic with a pure, crisp white background and uses a clean serif font (like Georgia or Palatino) throughout, aligning with a professional, approachable scientific feel. The overall aspect ratio is 4:3. No drop shadows, gradients, 3D effects, or decorative icons are present. All arrows are straight and orthogonal, emphasizing clear, sequential data flow.
